# Native backup v1 synthetic fixture

`device-backup-v1.synthetic.json` was generated by the production C native
backup encoder through `firmware/tests/test_backup.c` for v0.53. It contains
the original demo character, two numeric effects, synthetic coin counts,
settings and twenty invented rolls. It contains no personal character,
Beyond response, credentials or remote content.

The static fixture keeps `npm test` independent of the firmware toolchain.
`npm run firmware:test` also generates a fresh larger snapshot and compares
the PC preview with the actual C encoder output using `scripts/check-backup.js`.
